jobs.title: Senior Vice President, Health Digital
jobs.description:
Edelman is a voice synonymous with trust, reimagining a future where the currency of communication is action. Our culture thrives on three promises: boldness is possibility, empathy is progress, and curiosity is momentum.

At Edelman, we understand diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging (DEIB) transform our colleagues, our company, our clients, and our communities. We are in relentless pursuit of an equitable and inspiring workplace that is respectful of all, reflects and represents the world in which we live, and fosters trust, collaboration and belonging.

Edelman is looking for a Senior Vice President, Health Digital
to help shape the future of digital marketing for some of the world's leading pharmaceutical brands. Sitting at the intersection of Edelman Health and Edelman Digital, this is an opportunity to lead sophisticated, integrated digital strategies that connect healthcare brands with patients, caregivers, and healthcare professionals in meaningful ways.

We're looking for a strategic digital leader who understands the complexities of pharmaceutical marketing and knows how to bring together creativity, technology, data, and regulatory expertise to deliver results. You'll serve as a trusted advisor to senior clients, lead multidisciplinary teams, and help build connected digital experiences that drive business impact.

If you're energized by solving complex challenges, shaping digital innovation in healthcare, and building high-performing teams, we'd love to hear from you.

Who You Are

You're a forward-thinking digital strategist with deep pharmaceutical marketing expertise and a passion for creating connected, impactful experiences. You understand how to navigate highly regulated environments without losing sight of creativity, innovation, or the audiences you're trying to reach.

You bring a strong point of view on the evolving digital landscape, from omnichannel engagement and personalized content to emerging search technologies and social platforms. You're equally comfortable advising senior executives, identifying growth opportunities, and bringing together specialists across disciplines to turn ambitious ideas into measurable results.

Above all, you're a collaborative leader who inspires teams, builds trusted client relationships, and sees opportunities where others see complexity.

What You'll Do

Lead digital strategy for major pharmaceutical clients, developing integrated branded and unbranded marketing programs across websites, CRM, paid media, SEO, generative engine optimization (GEO), and social.
Serve as a senior strategic advisor to clients, translating complex business challenges into innovative, audience-centered digital solutions that deliver measurable impact.
Shape connected digital ecosystems across healthcare professional (HCP), patient, and caregiver journeys, ensuring seamless experiences across channels and touchpoints.
Navigate pharmaceutical marketing regulations, including medical, legal, and regulatory (MLR) review, important safety information (ISI), and fair balance, to deliver compliant and engaging digital experiences.
Bring together cross-functional expertise across UX, analytics, media, CRM, content, and creative to deliver cohesive, high-performing digital programs.
Drive business growth by identifying organic opportunities, expanding digital capabilities within existing accounts, and contributing to new business development.
Build and inspire high-performing teams, providing strategic direction, mentorship, and opportunities for growth while fostering a collaborative and inclusive culture.

What We're Looking For

10+ years of health digital marketing experience within an agency environment, with a bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.
Deep experience in pharmaceutical digital marketing, including branded and unbranded campaigns targeting HCPs, patients, and caregivers.
Proven success leading digital strategy for complex, large-scale pharmaceutical accounts, with a strong understanding of omnichannel marketing and customer experience.
Expertise in developing integrated digital ecosystems spanning websites, CRM, paid media, search, social, and emerging digital technologies.
Strong understanding of pharmaceutical regulatory requirements, including MLR processes, ISI, fair balance, and indication-specific content.
Experience advising senior-level clients, influencing strategic decisions, and translating digital investments into measurable business outcomes.
Demonstrated ability to identify growth opportunities, contribute to new business wins, and expand client relationships.
Collaborative leadership style with experience guiding multidisciplinary teams, developing talent, and bringing together diverse perspectives to deliver impactful work.

We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

jobs.title: Director, Education Technology
jobs.description:
At CPA Western School of Business (CPAWSB), we are committed to delivering innovative, high-quality education that prepares learners for a rapidly evolving profession.

Reporting to the Executive Vice President, Learning & Innovation, the Director, Education Technology provides strategic leadership and operational oversight for CPAWSB's learning technologies, digital assessment platforms, system integrations, and emerging educational technology initiatives. You will lead the development and execution of a future-focused education technology strategy that supports teaching, learning, assessment, and learner success across the organization.

Working closely with leaders across Learning & Innovation, Information Services, and other departments, you will ensure CPAWSB's educational technology environment remains innovative, reliable, secure, and aligned with organizational priorities.

Duties and Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

Develop and execute CPAWSB's education technology strategy.
Provide strategic advice to senior leadership on technology-enabled learning, assessment, and student support.
Establish governance frameworks, policies, standards, and best practices for educational technology.
Lead strategic initiatives that enhance the learner, educator, and staff experience.
Manage operational and capital budgets and ensure investments deliver measurable value.

Educational Technology Management

Provide leadership and oversight of CPAWSB's educational technology ecosystem, including Canvas, assessment platforms, integrations, and related technologies.
Ensure high-quality, responsive support services for students, staff, and contractors.
Monitor system performance and key metrics to drive continuous improvement.
Lead quality assurance, testing, documentation, and governance activities.
Manage vendor relationships, contracts, and service level agreements.
Ensure compliance with privacy, security, accessibility, and data governance requirements.

Innovation & Digital Learning

Monitor emerging trends in educational technology, artificial intelligence, learning analytics, and digital learning.
Evaluate, pilot, and implement innovative technologies that improve teaching, learning, assessment, and learner support.
Develop business cases and recommendations for technology investments.
Lead vendor evaluations, procurement processes, and implementation planning.
Champion innovation and foster a culture of continuous improvement across the organization.

Leadership & Team Development

Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing education technology team.
Foster collaboration across academic, operational, and technology functions.
Support organizational change initiatives related to technology adoption.
Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders, external partners, and peer institutions.
Model CPAWSB's values and commitment to learner success.

Qualifications

Education and Experience

Master's degree in Education, Educational Technology, Instructional Design, Information Technology, Business Administration, Learning Sciences, or a related discipline. Equivalent combinations of education and experience may be considered.
CPA designation or accounting education experience is considered an asset.
7-10 years of progressive leadership experience in educational technology, digital learning, instructional technology, or a related field.
Minimum three years of teaching experience.
Demonstrated success leading complex technology initiatives, organizational change, and cross-functional teams.
Experience managing learning management systems, digital learning ecosystems, and education technology platforms.
Experience managing budgets, vendors, and strategic technology investments.

Knowledge and Skills

Deep understanding of learning management systems (Canvas preferred), digital assessment tools, system integrations, learning analytics, and AI-enabled educational technologies.
Knowledge of educational technology architecture, governance, privacy, accessibility, and information security principles.
Strong strategic thinking, financial acumen, and project leadership skills.
Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
Exceptional relationship-building, influencing, and change leadership capabilities.
Curiosity, innovation, and a commitment to continuous improvement.

This role is eligible for hybrid work. The CPAWSB is based primarily in Edmonton, Calgary, and Vancouver. If based outside of these centers, the successful candidate may be required to travel to a CPAWSB office from time to time, or as required. 

The salary range for this role is $121,700 to $182,500, depending on qualifications, experience and internal equity. Along with a comprehensive benefits package, CPAWSB offers an exciting and challenging work environment, as well as a company culture that values: Excellence, Integrity, Collaboration, Innovation, Responsiveness, and Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion.

How to Apply

If you're excited about the opportunity to reimagine learning through technology and lead innovative initiatives that support learner success, we'd love to hear from you.

Please submit your resume and cover letter by November 13, 2026,
to humanresources@cpawsb.ca. We thank all candidates for their applications, only those candidates considered for this position will be contacted directly. 

CPAWSB is committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible workplace. Accommodations are available throughout the recruitment process upon request.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Data Engineering & Analytics
jobs.description:
Clario's data platforms power the clinical trial data our customers rely on. As Associate Director, Data Engineering & Analytics, you'll lead the global team responsible for building, operating, and modernizing our enterprise data platforms. You'll ensure production reliability, drive engineering excellence, and support modernization aligned with Clario's NxT.Lumen strategy while working closely with Product, Architecture, Data Governance, Quality, and customer-facing teams.

What You'll Do

Lead enterprise data engineering, integration, warehouse, analytics engineering, and API services.
Own end-to-end engineering delivery, including development, testing, validation, deployment, and production support.
Set technical direction and engineering standards with Architecture and Data & Analytics leadership.
Modernize legacy platforms, reduce technical debt, and drive migration and retirement plans aligned with NxT.Lumen.
Ensure production reliability through monitoring, SLAs, incident management, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement.
Lead technical responses to critical production and customer-impacting issues.
Establish standards for data modeling, CI/CD, automated testing, release management, observability, and documentation.
Partner with Data Quality on testing, reconciliation, and release readiness.
Ensure compliance with Clario SOPs, SDLC, validation requirements, and audit remediation.
Implement data governance, lineage, MDM, and security standards with Data Governance.
Translate product roadmaps and customer needs into scalable engineering solutions.
Own budgets, resource plans, delivery commitments, vendors, and global delivery capacity.
Track delivery, reliability, and quality metrics while proactively managing risks.
Build and develop a high-performing global team with clear ownership and knowledge transfer.
Represent the team in architecture, customer, and executive forums.

What You'll Bring

10+ years in enterprise data engineering, software engineering, integration, or data warehousing.
5+ years leading engineering teams, including distributed or global teams.
Strong technical experience with Databricks, Snowflake, AWS, Talend, Airflow, Python, SQL, APIs, and ETL/ELT.
Experience managing end-to-end engineering delivery, enterprise production platforms, and legacy modernization.
Experience establishing CI/CD, automated testing, release management, and engineering standards.
Experience managing technical roadmaps, budgets, resources, and vendors.
Working knowledge of data privacy, security, and technology risk.
Experience with regulated SDLC, computer-system validation (CSV), SOPs, and audit readiness.
SAFe or scaled-agile experience.
AI-enabled engineering and automation experience.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Nice to Have

Life sciences, clinical research, pharma, CRO, or healthcare experience.
Knowledge of clinical data transfer and integration standards.
Databricks Lakehouse/Unity Catalog and modern DataOps experience.
Legacy data warehouse and ETL modernization experience.
Customer-facing SaaS experience.

At Clario, a part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, a part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, our purpose is to transform lives by unlocking better evidence. It’s a cause that unites and inspires us. It’s why we come to work—and how we empower our people to make a positive impact every day. Whether you're advancing clinical science, building innovative technology, or supporting our global teams, your work helps bring life-changing therapies to patients faster.

jobs.title: Vice President of Financial Planning Analysis
jobs.description:
VP of Finance

Hybrid (2 Days in Vaughan)

Oakbridge Search Partners has been retained by a leading, multi-entity Canadian services organization to hire a VP of FP&A. This is a ground-floor opportunity to build the finance function for a new initiative with the backing of an established parent organization.

The Opportunity

As VP of Finance, you'll own financial management, reporting, and controls for a complex, multi-workstream initiative. You'll lead budgeting, forecasting, treasury, and audit, design processes and controls from scratch, and report into the broader organization. This role is for a builder who takes ownership, makes decisions independently, and wants to shape something from day one.

What You'll Do

Own financial tracking and reporting (monthly, quarterly, and ad hoc) for leadership and the ownership group
Build and maintain budgets and forecasts across all workstreams; monitor variances and recommend corrective action
Lead treasury management and the annual audit process
Design and implement financial processes and internal controls
Review vendor contracts, invoices, and POs, and support procurement decisions with financial analysis
Partner with Project Managers and Leadership to provide financial input into planning and prioritization
Identify and mitigate financial risk while ensuring compliance with policies and standards

What You Bring

CPA designation (CA, CMA, or CGA legacy designations accepted)
8 to 12 years of progressive finance experience, including 3 to 5 years in a senior finance leadership role
Direct experience managing an annual audit and preparing financials under ASPE
Strong technical accounting skills and Canadian tax knowledge (corporate income tax, GST/HST, payroll compliance)
Proficiency with accounting software (QuickBooks, Sage, NetSuite, or similar) and advanced Excel modelling
Comfort operating at both a strategic and hands-on level, from presenting to ownership to booking a month-end entry
Experience managing financials for projects, operations, or business units in a fast-paced, multi-stakeholder environment
Nice to have: experience in project-based environments (construction, technology, implementation, or consulting), procurement and vendor management, or system implementation projects

Location & Travel

Hybrid, with two days per week in office at one of the organization's Ontario locations, plus travel to other Ontario sites approximately twice per month.

What's Offered

Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits, plus mental health and wellness resources
Three weeks of vacation to start, paid sick and personal days
Full company shutdown between Christmas and New Year's
A collaborative, supportive culture with a genuine commitment to growth and development
